SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No. D. 3979.
S. B. REC.
3579
Special Branch S. 2. Station
Date September 9. 1932.

Subject (in full) Despatch No. 686 dated August 31, 1932 from the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau on the subject of an ex-communist named Zau Kyuin (曹均).
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by O.B.Ku. S.I.

In accordance with the memo of the Superintendent,
Special Branch, dated September 5, on the attached file concerning
an ex-communist named Zau Kyuin (曹均) residing at No. 615
Yung Foh Li (永福里), Miller Road, I have to report that this
individual upon being interviewed by a member of this office
on September 6 gave the following information regarding himself :
"My name is Zau Kyuin (曹均) age 20, native of Siao San
(蕭山), Chekiang, unemployed, residing at 615 Yung Foh Li,
Miller Road. At the age of thirteen, I came to Shanghai and
studied French in the Franco-Chinese Municipal School, Boulevard
de Montigny, French Concession, where I remained for three years.
I then studied for two years in the Aurora University, 233
Avenue Dubail, I did not graduate from that university. On
December 23, 1930 I proceeded to Hangchow to visit my brother-in-
law named Sung Ping Chien (沈炳銓) who owns a silk weaving
factory there. About one week after my arrival, I was arrested
by the Hangchow authorities on a charge of being a communist
my
because/name was mentioned in a letter, intercepted by the
Hangchow authorities, which was sent to one Song Tsu Ming (宋哲明)
by one Yu Ngoh Huin (于玉輝) in Shanghai c/o Shu Hung (許垣).
Shu Hung, who was also in Hangchow, and I were summarily arrested
and sentenced to one year and ten months imprisonment respectively.
As a result of the 30th session of the "Pai Sing Yuen" (反省院)
(a reformatory caring for political offenders who, after serving
half their term of imprisonment, are allowed to enter and study
provided such prisoners were arrested on suspicion and have been
recommended by the Gaol Supt. for good behaviour), I was
eventually released in May 1932. After this I lived in my
brother-in-law's home for one month and then returned to

主题（全称） 上海市公安局1932年8月31日关于一名名为曹均（Zau Kyuin）的前共产党分子的第686号公函。
由督察顾保华（Kuh Pao-hwa）撰写。由警官古（O.B.Ku.）转交。警探。

根据特务科警司9月5日关于附件中居住在米勒路（Miller Road）永福里615号的前共产党分子曹均（Zau Kyuin）的备忘录，本人谨报告如下：该人于9月6日接受本处人员问询时，提供了以下关于其个人的信息：
“我叫曹均（Zau Kyuin），年龄20岁，浙江萧山（Siao San）人，无业，现居米勒路永福里615号。十三岁时来到上海，在法租界蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）的中法学堂学习法语，在那里读了三年。随后我在杜拜尔路（Avenue Dubail）233号的震旦大学学习了两年，但未从该校毕业。1930年12月23日，我前往杭州探望我的姐夫沈炳銓（Sung Ping Chien），他在那里拥有一家丝织厂。抵达约一周后，我被杭州当局以共产党嫌疑逮捕，因为杭州当局截获了一封由上海的于玉輝（Yu Ngoh Huin）寄给宋哲明（Song Tsu Ming）（许垣（Shu Hung）转交）的信件，信中提到了我的名字。当时也在杭州的许垣（Shu Hung）和我随即被捕，并分别被判处一年十个月的监禁。由于参加了‘反省院’（Pai Sing Yuen）（一种收容政治犯的感化机构，服刑过半且经监狱长推荐表现良好的嫌疑人可进入学习）的第30期学习，我最终于1932年5月获释。此后我在我姐夫家住了一个月，然后返回

Shanghai. I am at present staying with my father Zau Zeu Ching
( 曹 芸 卿 ) who is the owner of the Yun Mei Tsa ( 韻 美 齋 ) Curio
Shop on Foochow Road, and I am studying French by myself with
a view to seeking employment. I have two brothers; the elder
one named Zau Ting ( 曹 昇 ) who was formerly employed as a clerk
in the Head Office of the Chinese Post Office, Shanghai, and has
now been transferred to Yunan, and the younger one named Zan
Zung Piao ( 曹 仁 標 ) who is assisting my brother-in-law Sung Ping
Chien in his business at Hangchow. My mother died in 1931.
My father is the chief tenant of house No.615 Yung Foh Li, Miller
Road, and pays a monthly rental of $30. The upstairs rooms of the
premises are vacant, but the room above kitcehn is rented by a
Japanese."

A quiet watch was kept on September 7 and 8 outside
No.615 Yung Foh Li, Miller Road, on the movements of Zau Kyuin
but he was not seen at any time to leave the premises. It was
later learned that he had been forbidden by his father to leave
the house or receive any visitors for fear that he may come again
into contact with bad associates.

According to the despatch from the Public Safety Bureau,
it appears that they received their information concerning Zau
Kyuin from the Hangchow authorities.

（批：Please acknowledge letter
from B of P.S. - matter
having attention J.R.）
（批：Luk Tso-hua
D. I.）

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海。目前我与父亲曹芸卿（Zau Zeu Ching）同住，他是福州路韵美斋（Yun Mei Tsa）古玩店的店主，我正在自学法语以谋求职业。我有两个兄弟；哥哥叫曹昇（Zau Ting），原在上海中国邮政总局任职员，现已调往云南；弟弟叫曹仁標（Zan Zung Piao），正在杭州协助我姐夫沈炳銓做生意。母亲于1931年去世。父亲是米勒路永福里615号房屋的主承租人，每月租金30元。该处楼上房间空置，但厨房上面的房间租给了一名日本人。”

9月7日和8日，对米勒路永福里615号曹均的行动进行了秘密监视，但任何时候都未见他离开该住所。后获悉，因其父担心他再次与不良分子接触，已禁止他离家或接待任何访客。

根据市公安局的公函，他们似乎是从杭州当局那里获得的关于曹均的情报。

（批注：请回复公安局来信 - 事项正在处理中 J.R.）
（批注：陆佐华（Luk Tso-hua）
督察。）

特务科负责警官。

S. B. REC.
No. D 23774

Translation of Despatch No. 686 dated August 31, 1932
From the Public Safety Bureau to the Commissioner of
Police.

The undermentioned has received an order
from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai instructing
that the movements of a Chinese named Zau Kyuin (曹均),
who has repented of his folly of being connected with
the Communist Party, be closely watched from time to
time in order to ascertain if he has actually severed
his connections with the Communists. The order
further adds that Zau Kyuin should be protected according
to law.

As the present address of Zau Kyuin is
in the Settlement, I hereby request you to instruct
the Police Station concerned to watch his movements and afford
him protection.

Particulars of Zau Kyuin and his photo
are enclosed herewith.

(Sgd.) Wen Ying Sing,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau.

S. B. REC.
编号 D 23774

1932年8月31日上海市公安局致警务处处长的第686号公函译文。

下述人员接到大上海市政府命令，指示对一名名为曹均（Zau Kyuin）的中国人进行不定期的严密监视，此人已悔悟其与共产党关联之愚行，监视旨在查明其是否确实切断了与共产党的联系。命令还指出，应依法保护曹均。

鉴于曹均目前的住址在租界内，特此请求阁下指令相关巡捕房监视其行动并提供保护。

随函附上曹均的个人资料及其照片。

（签名）温应星（Wen Ying Sing），
公安局局长。
